Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Noi di ABB aiutiamo le industrie a operare in modo più snello e pulito, e ogni persona qui contribuisce a rendere possibile tutto questo. Avrai la possibilità di assumere un ruolo di leadership, sarai supportato nella tua crescita e sarai orgoglioso dell'impatto che creeremo insieme. Unisciti a noi per contribuire a far funzionare ciò che fa funzionare il mondo. Questa Posizione Risponde a Global Marketing and Communications Manager, Drive Products __ ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion Location This role is open globally, but location is set in Europe - with a preference for Finland (Helsinki), Italy (Sesto San Giovanni), Germany (Mannheim) - and US (New Berlin, Wisconsin). The work model is hybrid . Key Responsibilities In this role, you will lead global marketing and communications for industrial drives portfolio, including portfolio promotion and new product launches, deepen OEM partnerships and create compelling storytelling. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help strengthen market positioning, support business growth, and ensure marketing initiatives deliver measurable impact across global markets. This role reports to Global Marketing and Communication Manager, Motion Drive Products. You Will Be Mainly Accountable For Develop and execute annual global marketing and communications plans and roadmaps for industrial segment and applications, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Lead end-to-end global product launches and marketing campaigns, ensuring consistent execution and measurable business impact across markets. Manage marketing budget allocation, set targets and monitor campaign performance metrics, providing analysis to optimize campaign effectiveness. Create compelling storytelling that translates concepts into customer-centric value propositions that demonstrate understanding of customer needs and competitive differentiation. Collaborate closely with Sales, Product Management, R&D, regional marketing teams, and external partners to gather market insights and strengthen go-to-market effectiveness. Support local marketing and communications teams in localizing and developing industry campaigns. Qualifications Bachelor's or higher degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related fields. 5+ years of experience in related roles, ideally in B2B product marketing Proven experience building and executing impactful global marketing plans and integrated campaigns Proficiency in digital marketing tools, AI, analytics, and content development. Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder‑management skills. A mindset to innovate, take ownership, and drive continuous improvement Fluency in English and valid work authorization in the hiring country. What's in it for you? We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward. Contribute to a collective vision. This is where progress takes flight, teams turn ideas into impact, and we define what’s next. Run What Runs the World. This opportunity is open to candidates in one or multiple countries that have adopted the European Pay Transparency Directive, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage. As a global medtech company, we are driven by our Vision of changing the trajectory of lives for a new day and our Mission to create ingenious solutions that ignite patient turnarounds. Our relentless commitment to patients and strong legacy of innovation in healthcare are the foundation of our future. If you're looking for a new chance, a new beginning, a new trajectory, LivaNova is where your talent can truly thrive. Join our talented team members worldwide to become a pioneer of tomorrow—because at LivaNova, we don’t just treat conditions — we aspire to alter the course of lives. Location: Remote – Europe (Italy, France, Germany, Spain or the UK) Travel: At least 50% About The Role At LivaNova, we are looking for a Senior Global Marketing Manager – Digital Solutions to drive the global marketing strategy for our digital solutions portfolio, with a strong focus on software, data and value-based healthcare. This is an opportunity to bring a fresh perspective to the way digital solutions are positioned, launched and developed in a global healthcare environment. You will work with global stakeholders and lead a team of two product management professionals, helping translate digital capabilities into compelling market propositions and sustainable business opportunities. Responsibilities Define and drive the global marketing strategy for the digital solutions portfolio, with a focus on software, data and value-based healthcare. Lead software commercialization activities, translating product capabilities into compelling value propositions and go-to-market strategies. Support the launch and growth of digital products, leveraging software business models such as Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) and recurring revenue. Collaborate with global and cross-functional stakeholders to align product positioning, marketing priorities and commercialization plans. Identify opportunities to strengthen the value proposition of digital solutions and communicate their relevance to customers and the healthcare environment. Lead and support two direct reports Your Profile Proven experience in Product Marketing, Product Management or a related commercial role, with hands-on experience launching software products. Strong understanding of software business models, particularly SaaS, subscriptions and recurring revenue. Experience developing product positioning, value propositions and go-to-market strategies. Strong communication, strategic thinking and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across global teams. Some people management experience is desirable; the ability and motivation to develop as a leader are also valued. Willingness to travel internationally at least 50% of the time and flexibility to work across global time zones when required. Proximity to an international airport is an advantage. What We Can Offer You In addition to providing you with a supportive, inclusive and collaborative environment where you will feel empowered to take ownership and drive meaningful change, we will reward you with competitive, market-aligned packages across all locations. Actual compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, and internal equity. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Build the future of the AI Data Cloud. Join the Snowflake team. Our EMEA Partners & Alliances organization is seeking a Partner Sales Director to join our growing team in EMEA South (Italy). GSI and RSI Partners offer consulting services and implement Snowflake in customer environments and refer new customers to Snowflake. We are looking for a self driven, go getter to help grow these Partners into profitable revenue streams and accelerate our Partner Ecosystem and the growth of the business. We are seeking a candidate with a proven track record of strong communication skills, diplomacy in successfully working with difficult partners (it’s easy when everything is going fine) and strong business acumen in growing a business/ channel/ partnership. Reporting to the Regional Partner Director for EMEA South, you will have a unique opportunity to work for a disruptive company at the forefront of the Data & AI revolution, and lead the development of a vibrant Partner community. AS A PARTNER SALES DIRECTOR (ITALY) YOU WILL: Manage a portfolio of high performing Global Systems Integrators (GSI's) and Regional SI’s (RSIs) to achieve partnership goals such as net new customers and consumption Support your partners in their go-to-market activities (business planning, pipeline development, QBR, marketing, enablement sales activities across different Go-To-Market options…) Ensure successful execution of the business plan by developing and managing relationships across functional areas within the partner Work with the partner to expand the partnership into new strategic areas (new Service Lines and Industry Verticals) Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders (typically Partner/Managing Director Level) Organise and execute events with and for our partner community Pitch value proposition of Snowflake partnership on all levels (up to C-Level) Ensure alignment of all relevant stakeholders on pursues in joint accounts OUR IDEAL PDM WILL HAVE: 7+ years of professional experience in Channel Management, Software/Services Sales, Consulting, and/or Business Development in Cloud or Software Technology Experience in working with SIs (such as KPMG, EY, CapGemini, Atos, etc.) to leverage their strategic influence to drive technology sales in a joint sales offering Proven experience in delivering strong results in pipeline generation and bookings, by leveraging existing and recruiting targeted new partners Cloud Technology, AI/ML, Data, Analytics, API and platform experience and understanding Ability to build, lead and implement strategy in a cross-functional environment Strong executive selling and business development skills; proven ability to understand different partner GTM and organizational models Ability to design and present business plans, track and articulate program progress, design and document program guidelines for distribution throughout the organization (all levels) and for external use MUST HAVE: Excellent communication skills, verbal & written in Italian & and English. Strong problem solving skills and ability to organize priorities in a dynamic environment Bachelor's degree Be able to travel between 25% - 50% in some months WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE: Unique opportunity to work on a truly disruptive software product! Develop a brand new set of ecosystem alliances for Snowflake making data more accessible to customers Develop, lead and execute industry-changing initiatives Learn from the best! Join a dedicated, experienced team of professionals Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact?
